messages:
erin_sales: Heads up team, Prospect: Meridian Systems. They returned the RFI and asked for a compact capability matrix (hosted/dedicated/private), explicit HSM/KMS handling, a 4-week Dedicated trial pricing proposal with overage terms, and a proposed POC milestone schedule. I put the PDF in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/meridian-rfi (internal). Need SME input by EOD to lock the SOW.

raj_engineer: Quick Q: the doc lists 35k tokens/sec peak during sim tests. Is that aggregate across all endpoints or per-model? Also they want KV cache to persist between session restarts.

erin_sales: Meridian wrote: "35k tokens/sec peak across our user flows; typical user sessions show 800-1.5k TPS. Preference for INT8 quantized models for cost." They also asked for a 99.9% availability objective for the POC window.

katie_se: Short answer: Hosted won't expose HSM; Dedicated gives reserved GPUs with sticky routing and prefix KV support; Private supports BYO-HSM and VPC peering. I'll build a capability matrix spreadsheet and propose two perf configs (latency-first, cost-first).

michael_ops: Ops estimate for Private + HSM: network peering + tunnel setup ~1.5w, infra provisioning 1w, validation & smoke 1w, load tuning 2w. Total ~5.5 weeks. Also: persistent KV across sessions needs stateful routing and more RAM on nodes.

sam_sales: Proposed trial pricing: 4-week Dedicated trial at $16k reserved baseline + standard token usage. Offer an optional annual commit at 18% discount and 1-week burst credit. For overage: standard token rates apply after reserved capacity; include auto-scale ceilings to avoid surprise bills.

raj_engineer: Note: persistent KV cache across sessions will decrease peak throughput ~10% unless we increase batch sizes or add nodes. I'll prepare numbers for both configs and include expected latency impact.

katie_se: Capability matrix snippet (will expand in spreadsheet):

```
Hosted: quick onboarding, shared KMS (no HSM), 99.5% SLA, streaming, limited custom routing
Dedicated: reserved GPU pool, sticky routing for KV, 99.9% SLA, configurable autoscale
Private: customer VPC, BYO-HSM support, private KMS/HSM integration, longer setup lead time
```

maria_csm: We should request anonymized sample payloads (max seq len, QPS patterns, PII handling rules) to baseline evaluation. Also ask for any eval prompt sets they'd like us to run.

legal_bot: Legal/security note: decline unlimited audit access. Suggest audit logs retained for 90 days during POC with SOC2 addendum language. Recommend DPA + standard encryption in transit/at rest clause. I'll draft a short security appendix.

erin_sales: Action items: @katie_se draft full capability matrix and attach spreadsheet; @raj_engineer produce perf profiles for latency vs cost configs; @michael_ops confirm infra lead times and firewall needs; @legal_bot draft security appendix + DPA language; @sam_sales prepare pricing slide and SOW bullets. Target to send consolidated response to Meridian by 2147900000. :thumbsup:

sam_sales: I'll assemble pricing + SOW bullets and include a canary rollback plan and brief POC runbook for reliability assurances.

katie_se: I'll upload the spreadsheet to the drive folder in ~2.5 hours and ping here when ready.

raj_engineer: I'll draft a short perf runbook including batch sizes, KV retention settings, and expected throughput impact. Need their sample payloads to validate.

erin_sales: Thanks all. I'll push Meridian for sample data and aim to close the SOW call tomorrow if we hit EOD. :rocket:
